technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term trend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) but lacks near-term momentum confirmation; multiple short-term indicators are bearish with price below key moving averages, making this a poor swing entry candidate.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 88 days present material risk with insufficient smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; market fear (42/100) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and weak conviction from junior members limit bullish conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at 81.9 indicates crisis-level market stress; earnings in 88 days poses moderate event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) with supertrend confirmation and price near support (128.60) offers potential mean-reversion entry in fear-driven market (VIX 81.9).
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive short-term momentum collapse (RSI <40, MACD negative, stoch bearish cross, price below all key MAs) combined with zero smart money conviction, high earnings risk in 88 days, and macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) make this a structurally weak swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (128.60) with long-term trend structure intact, the confluence of short-term momentum collapse (RSI <40, MACD negative, stoch bearish cross), zero smart money conviction, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 81.9, inverted yield curve) creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs mean-reversion potential.
decision.primary_risk: Macro recession signals combined with earnings event in 88 days and complete absence of institutional accumulation could trigger further downside break below support, invalidating the swing thesis.
